the_finding: The delivered width and the RECALL width are the same knob in the flown cell: PhaseSupplySpec.k is passed to the provider as top_k_per_dimension AND the fuser's coverage is m=top_l=8, so at k=8 the recall truncates to eight candidates by cosine BEFORE the ranker runs and an agreement reweighting can only permute the eight it already delivers. The 2026-09-26 diagnostic simulated a full-width recall (60) followed by a delivery of eight. This read measures both widths: at the committed width the treatment is inert, and at width 60 with fuse_coverage unchanged it reproduces the diagnostic. The registered cell therefore has to widen k while leaving fuse_coverage at m=8/c=1/top_l=8 -- which costs no rendered entry, as the delivered-width histogram beside each block shows.
